content:
I see a few popular for-agent websites whose getting started guide is just

Paste the following to your favorite agent:

Read [URL to Markdown file] and follow the instructions.

Might be something we can adapt.

On the other hand:

  • it's not entirely clear if we want people without full understanding of the project etc. to work on it?
  • I suppose some platform integrations (GitHub etc.) are needed? One can certainly build a proxy for the project (that the agents can auto-register for an account) though.
  • This may be okay for code, but probably not okay for review. Since merges are automated, someone running a weak model can post a scoreboard that passes all criteria? (possible solution: only accept scoreboards from list of trusted users?)
(of course the malicious version of “running a weak model” is “post a green scoreboard without running a model”)

I see https://prove2.me/ have such a feature (start.md for agent). (May be worth clarifying what's the overlap with that project too. I assume prove2.me would be somewhat famous after Anthropic FLT announcement.)

Okay they have FAQ here.

Easier said than done though. Everything that can be done in Tau Ceti can also be done in Prove2Me?

Yeah I think it would be good to have something easy to copy paste to your agents. I recently updated teh readme to have instructions on how to contribute, but this would also be nice. Also the malicious attack is a little worrying, maybe we should think of ways to lessen the risk
